verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, so latency and throughput are a fair question for it. The evidence pack makes no claim about time-to-first-token, tokens-per-second, latency SLAs or high-throughput serving. Streaming and prompt caching are listed as capabilities, but they are adjacent features, not evidence of fast or high-throughput generation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve latency-sensitive workloads with fast time-to-first-token and high-throughput generation
